content: Firestore free tier (Spark) quotas per the official quota docs: 1 GiB stored, 50,000 document reads/day, 20,000 document writes/day, 20,000 deletes/day, 10 GiB/month outbound. On Spark, exceeding the limit does not bill you - the Firestore API stops working and returns 'resource exhausted' until the daily reset (Reddit r/Firebase). With open security rules, any third party who learns the project ID can burn the daily quota. Leaked onSnapshot listeners multiply reads: a stacked listener reads the full document set again each time. Blaze pricing is $0.03/100k reads and $0.09/100k writes with a free-tier allowance that still applies.
